amendment_notice: V3 is a PROSPECTIVE CORRECTIVE AMENDMENT, created AFTER initial exploratory/confirmatory outcomes were partially observed under V2. It is NOT a pristine pre-outcome preregistration. V3 corrects critical methodological and inferential flaws while strictly preserving live training processes, historical records, and cryptographic seals.
amendment_reasons: A. Single-view GRAPH_ONLY confirmatory values in progress reports were evaluated from historical Stage-A2 checkpoints rather than fresh prospective runs matched to the prospective Nineplus campaign harness.

B. Downstream linear probe in legacy protocol was fitted and evaluated using an 80/20 split inside the Validation representation pool rather than training on Train representations and evaluating on the full fixed Validation population.
C. Legacy 80/20 probe split depended on model seed RNG, causing different models to be evaluated on different validation subsets.
D. Administrative wall-clock watcher (17:00 deadline) risked truncating live Multi-View Seed 7 training and misclassifying administrative stopping as scientific early stopping.
E. Previous progress reports contained speculative and unsupported causal claims exceeding observational empirical evidence.

sequence_seeds_classification.policy: Primary H2 confirmatory inference uses strictly seeds 42, 7, 999. Seeds 1337 and 2024 provide supplementary exploratory robustness context and must not be described as 5/5 canonical confirmatory seeds.

primary_h2_architectures.description: Transformer Sequential Encoder (4-layer, d=128, MEP + MPP + Time SSL). Backbones from prospective confirmatory runs (Seeds 42, 7, 999) are eligible and preserved. Probes must be recomputed under V3 protocol.

Temporal Graph Neural Network single-view baseline. Must be trained freshly and prospectively under the identical Nineplus campaign harness (same HDFS data authority, same Train/Val membership hashes, 12-epoch ceiling, patience=3 early stopping, seeds 42, 7, 999, V3 probe protocol, zero Test access).

Joint Multi-View Architecture connecting Sequence View, Temporal Graph View, VICReg Alignment, and Gated Dynamic Fusion. Seed 42 backbone preserved with probe recomputation; Seed 7 live training preserved to natural completion; Seed 999 mandatory and deferred.

probe_protocol.name: TRAIN_FIT_FULL_FIXED_VALIDATION_EVALUATE
probe_protocol.step_1_representation_extraction: Extract frozen representations for all 35,000 Train sessions from the frozen model backbone.
probe_protocol.step_2_label_acquisition: Acquire downstream training anomaly labels from authorized training-label vault (experiments/runs/data/vault/hdfs_probe_labels_train.pt).
probe_protocol.step_3_probe_fitting: Fit capacity-controlled linear/logistic probe W in R^{128 x 1} (bce loss with logits, lr=1e-2, weight_decay=1e-4, 50 epochs, batch_size=256) exclusively on Train representations.
probe_protocol.step_4_probe_freeze: Freeze linear probe parameters; zero further optimization.
probe_protocol.step_5_val_extraction: Extract frozen representations for all 7,500 sessions in the fixed Validation split.
probe_protocol.step_6_val_evaluation: Evaluate frozen probe across ALL 7,500 fixed Validation sessions (100% population coverage).

membership_invariants.invariance_rule: Validation membership is strictly identical across all architectures and model seeds.

probe_rng.decoupling_rule: Probe training RNG is locked and strictly decoupled from backbone model training seed.

metric_terminology.rationale: Average Precision is calculated via precision-recall curve interpolation/step integration; it is distinct from generic PR-AUC approximations and must be precisely labeled as Average Precision (AP).

legacy_probe_status.role: Historical execution record. Retained in audit trail but strictly excluded from final confirmatory H2 decision matrix.

historical_graph_status.role: Exploratory reference derived from Stage A2 checkpoints. Excluded from final matched H2 confirmatory matrix; fresh Graph-only training required.

multi_view_seed42_status.note: Reported strictly as FAIL_UNDER_PREREGISTERED_THRESHOLD. Model artifact is preserved; single seed failure does not prejudge final multi-seed H2 verdict.

multi_view_seed999_status.execution_policy: Mandatory member of confirmatory triad [42, 7, 999]; deferred to follow-up execution turn.

administrative_pause_policy.rule: Wall-clock deadline or operating schedule is NOT a scientific stopping rule.
administrative_pause_policy.procedure: If execution must pause for machine usage or cooling, wait for current epoch completion, save clean epoch checkpoint, mark status ADMINISTRATIVE_PAUSE, and resume identical training process later.
prohibitions: DO NOT mark early_stopped=true on administrative pause.
DO NOT mark status COMPLETED on administrative pause.
DO NOT suppress mandatory seeds on administrative pause.

scientific_early_stopping_policy.rule: Patience = 3 epochs without improvement in validation loss, or completion of epoch 12 ceiling.
scientific_early_stopping_policy.enforcement: Evaluated strictly by training runner validation loop.

noninferiority_margin_status.nature: Study-specific practical tolerance defined by authors; not a universal standard or literature-derived constant. Locked against post-hoc modification.

statistical_hierarchy.bootstrap_role: Paired cluster bootstrap on validation sessions (cluster=session, 2000 resamples, seed 10007) is restricted strictly to quantifying within-seed finite sample uncertainty. FORBIDDEN from pooling across seeds or substituting for training seed replication.

allowed_inferences: Observational reporting of empirical AP, ROC-AUC, and latent variance under specified probe protocols.
Direct seed-to-seed and aggregate comparisons under matched evaluation protocols.
Hypothesis generation regarding alignment regularization, graph connectivity, and sequence predictability as candidate mechanisms for targeted future testing.
forbidden_inferences: DO NOT assert Gated Fusion 'proved' compensation of graph information.
DO NOT assert HDFS linearity 'caused' Sequence-only superiority.
DO NOT assert VICReg 'caused' over-regularization or negative transfer without matched unaligned ablation.
DO NOT assert Multi-View superiority on DARPA/provenance systems without empirical campaign evidence.
DO NOT assert graph sparsity is proven cause of performance differences.
DO NOT conflate temporal/graph dependency with causal mechanism.
